_comment: add-police. Stars added per witnessed crime; distances in metres, times in seconds.

helicopter._comment: update-police-pursuit: slower than a fast car (35 m/s is about 126 km/h; fast cars top out at 150-190), so it can be outrun in the open as well as lost under cover.

canopy._comment: update-police-pursuit: dense canopy hides the player from the helicopter. A tree counts when at least min_trees trees (itself included) stand within group_m; street-tree rows have about 3. The sight ray must pass min_depth_m through such crowns.
